name: Cooling mattress pad (Eight Sleep)

card.summary: An app-connected bed cover that heats and cools; praised for temperature control, subscription-dependent, no looks trials.
card.price: About $180-288/yr subscription on top of hardware
card.note: Many features require a subscription and cloud connection.

quick.overview:
Eight Sleep makes a bed cover that actively heats or cools the sleeping surface and tracks sleep.

Reviewers praise the temperature control; the product has not been tested for appearance outcomes in the sources reviewed.
quick.mechanism: The cover circulates temperature-controlled water through the bed and adjusts via an app.
quick.risks: A 2025 cloud outage left some units overheating, and most features require a subscription since 2023.

lead: Eight Sleep is an American company founded in 2014 that sells temperature-controlled bedding, notably the Pod smart mattress cover, which actively heats or cools the bed and tracks sleep. People in sleep-optimization circles buy it to hold a cool sleeping surface through the night. [1]

The appearance case for it runs through sleep. In a 2013 laboratory study at the Karolinska Institute, photographs of 10 people taken after 31 hours without sleep were rated by 40 observers as showing hanging eyelids, redder and more swollen eyes, darker circles, paler skin, more fine lines and droopier mouth corners than photos after normal sleep. [2] Users therefore treat anything that helps them sleep well, including a cooler bed, as part of looking rested.

Reviewers have praised the Pod's temperature control, though a later review said similar features are available elsewhere for less; since February 2023 most functions require a subscription. [1] No published trial has tested Eight Sleep products for appearance outcomes.

chain: Bed surface is cooled or warmed through the night
Aim is more and better sleep
Fewer visible fatigue cues such as dark circles, puffy eyes and pale skin
angle.text: Eight Sleep is used to control bed temperature in pursuit of better sleep. Better rested faces are rated as looking healthier and less tired in laboratory research on sleep and appearance, which is the link people draw to looks.

infobox: Roughly $180-288 per year for most features [1]

paras: The Pod provides variable temperature control and sleep tracking and integrates with Amazon Echo devices. Wikipedia's article does not explain the cooling and heating mechanism; Eight Sleep's own marketing describes it as 'sleep fitness'. [1]

The 2013 Sleep paper by Sundelin and colleagues photographed 10 adults (5 women) after normal sleep and after 31 hours of sleep deprivation. Forty observers rated the sleep-deprived faces as looking more fatigued and sadder, with hanging eyelids, redder and more swollen eyes, darker circles under the eyes, paler skin, more wrinkles or fine lines and droopier mouth corners. Glazed eyes, rash and tense lips did not differ significantly. [2]
This work concerns sleep loss in general; it did not involve mattress covers.

Eight Sleep was founded in 2014 by Matteo Franceschetti, Massimo Andreasi Bassi, Andrea Ballarini and Alexandra Zatarain, and funded early projects through a 2015 crowdfunding campaign. It later raised venture rounds, including a 2021 Series C led by Valor Equity Partners, acquired Span Health in 2022, and expanded to the United Arab Emirates in November 2024. A $50 million round was reported in March 2026. [1][3]

A 2021 review in The Strategist called the Pod the only product of its type offering perceptible temperature control; a later review from the same publication said its temperature-controlling features are easily found elsewhere for less. [1]

On October 20, 2025, an Amazon Web Services outage left some mattresses overheating or unable to cool; the founder apologized and Eight Sleep said it would add an offline 'outage mode'. [1][4][5] An unofficial open-source project has offered offline operation since July 2025. [1] Hacker News also carried threads in 2024 and 2025 on researchers gaining root access to a Pod 3 and on a back door allowing company engineers remote access to beds. [6][7]
No studies found testing Eight Sleep products for sleep or appearance outcomes.

timeline.event: Most Pod functions move behind a subscription. [1]
AWS outage disrupts Pod cooling; company promises an outage mode. [1][4]
